No artificial intelligence or simulated values are fabricated.

history.dailyPrecipSubtitle: Measured daily rain accumulation in millimeters
history.methodologyStation: 1. Station Observations (Last 1–14 Days): Sourced from land surface stations managed by national meteorological services (WMO Global Observing System). Data points represent calibrated physical thermometer, rain gauge, and anemometer readings.
history.methodologyReanalysis: 2. Reanalysis Estimates (ECMWF ERA5-Land Archive): Reanalysis blends historical surface station observations with satellite scatterometry and numerical physical conservation laws to fill spatial and temporal gaps on an equidistant 9 km grid.

advisor.nextPhaseEsp32: Next Phase: ESP32 IoT Soil Moisture Probes
advisor.esp32Desc: This weather advisor forms Module 1 of AgriSense. Soon, readings from physical ESP32 soil moisture, soil temperature, and NPK capacitive probes will fuse with this weather data for autonomous precision irrigation.
advisor.generalNotice: General Agronomic Recommendation Notice: These advisories are calculated using atmospheric models, WMO guidelines, and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration formulas. Always inspect physical soil conditions and verify with local agronomists or physical in-situ sensor probes before initiating heavy irrigation or spraying applications.

plantHealth.guidelinesTitle: Photography Guidelines for Accurate Diagnostic Recognition
plantHealth.guide1Desc: Photograph under bright diffused morning or afternoon sunlight. Avoid harsh shadows or strong flash reflections.
plantHealth.guide2Desc: Hold camera 15-25cm away, ensuring the target leaf blade fills at least 60% of the frame in sharp focus.
plantHealth.guide3Desc: Place a hand or plain surface behind the leaf to prevent background soil or weeds from interfering with recognition.
plantHealth.holdPhone: Hold phone steady 15-25cm above affected leaf blade
plantHealth.threeTier1: 1. Image Model Prediction: Identifies visual foliar symptoms from the submitted photograph.
plantHealth.threeTier2: 2. Weather-Related Risk Assessment: Evaluates whether atmospheric moisture and temperatures accelerate disease development.
plantHealth.threeTier3: 3. General Recommendations: Agronomic best practices. Weather conditions alone never constitute proof of plant infection.

settings.customCoords: કસ્ટમ GPS અક્ષાંશ અને રેખાંશ સેટ કરો
settings.attributionDesc: AgriSense integrates Open-Meteo's open-source atmospheric API, WMO (World Meteorological Organization) weather codes, and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith agrometeorological algorithms. Data is refreshed every 15 minutes.
